about: Invented voicemails, written the way speech-to-text returns them (missing punctuation, spoken numbers, false starts), labelled by hand before the first run. None had been seen when the rules were written; two rule fixes were made after the first run (see docs/eval.md). Caller ID is +16145550100 unless a case gives its own.
